title: Verify the work-order audit log still shows fee/discount entries even when the Fees & Discounts feature is off
custom_preconds:
1. A work order already has fee/discount audit-log entries.
2. The user has Work Orders: Create and Edit (to view the work-order audit log).
3. Ability to set the Fees & Discounts feature OFF.
custom_steps:
1. In Administration, turn the Fees & Discounts feature off.
2. Open the work order ⋮ menu, click 'Audit Log' to open the 'Work Order Log', and look for the fee/discount entries recorded earlier.
3. Turn the feature back on afterwards.
custom_expected:
1. Fee/discount audit-log entries stay visible in the Work Order Log even with the feature off (the one exception to 'feature off hides everything').
2. All other fee/discount screens are still hidden.
